description: Capabilities for the Tessera desktop main window. No static fs:scope on purpose: the only write is saveAttachment() right after the Save-as dialog, and tauri-plugin-dialog grants the picked path at runtime (allow_file in its save command). A blanket scope would instead hand every injected script write-anywhere. The clipboard is granted one direction per call site and no more — read-image for the Linux image-paste fallback (MarkdownEditor.vue), write-text for copyText() (utils/clipboard.js); the pairing is pinned by a test in src/lib.rs, because an ungranted call is rejected inside a try/catch and simply stops working.
